query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:49:00) My children. Kingsley the kitchen in this house is not a barbecue pit. But I will allow the suya if you keep the smoke outside. Adaeze, chin chin is expected, do not arrive without it. God willing, I have a full house this year. Oby, are you joining us from Enugu via video? 🙏
[3] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:09:00) Ifeoma I totally forgot!! okay SO Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that 😭
[4] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:04:00) My sister. Your knees. I am sorry to hear this. We will set up the video call first thing on the 25th before the food is served so you are there from the beginning, by His grace. Ifeoma, you are also coming I hope? 🙏
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:33:00) My children. Adaeze thank you. Oby, we will have you on screen from 11am, God willing. You will see everyone and we will see you. This family is growing up. By His grace we will all be in the same room again soon. 🙏
[7] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:29:00) okay so on it. I'll put together a running order: 1. Video call with Aunty Oby at 11am before food 2. Food from 2pm 3. Emeka's lot arriving by 12 based on his message. (no stress, I'll circulate it by Friday!) 😊
[8] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:17:00) Chi fair play, January is smarter. details, details on the timing but Christmas is family only, I respect that. Aunty Nkechi will have him vetted properly by spring 😂
[9] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[10] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:03:00) Chisom, I am glad you understand. This is a matter of how we have always operated as a family. Your grandfather insisted that when the family gathers, it gathers properly, all present, no distractions, the meal shared without rushing. That is what Christmas means in this family.
[11] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:08:00) My children, your Aunty Oby is speaking wisdom. And nobody thought to ask whether I need any help with the cooking this year? You know I will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but I will remember who did not ask. 🙂
[12] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:22:00) I will transfer mine on Wednesday from Enugu. Adaeze, you do this every year. I have said before that Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility with you. You should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
